name: Sinding-Larsen-Johansson Syndrome
definition: Traction-related pain at the inferior pole of the patella in skeletally immature athletes, analogous to an apophyseal overuse injury.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; radiographs are selective for atypical or traumatic presentations.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Symptoms usually resolve with maturity; persistent atypical pain needs reassessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu/Asthi-Snayu growth-related phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Traction-related pain at the inferior pole of the patella in skeletally immature athletes, analogous to an apophyseal overuse injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
